axioms: Each operation must be bound to a proven grade (tier); the executor default (sonnet) must never silently be handed master-grade work.

Inspection independence is cardinal: the master inspects against a fixed jig (the plan's criteria), never blends the fixed-gauge result with his own taste — a plan-conformance verdict must be an independent, non-overridable gate, not folded into flux-drive's review score.

Correction-not-repetition: a master never lets the same untrained hand re-strike a botched weld a third time the same way — the escalated attempt must change the hand (model tier), not just the attempt count.
Canonical form must be transmitted exactly; a plan with 'use your judgment' steps handed to an apprentice-grade executor is catastrophic, and nothing yet lints for it.
The lineage remembers the specific fault (a closed failure_mode vocabulary), not just 'failure happened', so faults of the same kind can be counted and compared across incidents.
When the master is away, sign-off falls to the most-senior journeyman (opus), never the apprentice.
failure_mode: Owns only human-transmission concerns (allocation, inspection independence, correction discipline, failure memory); does NOT own flow-volume, overflow, oscillation, or gauge/measurement (hydraulic's territory).
Sees fable-unavailability solely as a who-signs-off (authority) question, missing the relief-spillway/load-shedding framing.
Does not reason about statistical sufficiency, precedence-resolution determinism, or termination proofs; expresses mechanism bugs only through the forge metaphor (same-hand re-strike).
